```artifact
Feature: Login Functionality
  As a user
  I want to be able to log in to the system
  So that I can access my account

  Scenario: Successful Login
    Given the Admin has set up the Doctor with default password "doctor123"
    And the Admin has set up the Chemist with default password "chemist123"
    And the Admin has set up the Lab with default password "lab123"
    When I enter the username "doctor" and password "doctor123" in the login form
    Then I should see the Doctor's dashboard
    And the login form should be hidden

  Scenario: Invalid Username
    Given the Admin has set up the Doctor with default password "doctor123"
    And the Admin has set up the Chemist with default password "chemist123"
    And the Admin has set up the Lab with default password "lab123"
    When I enter the username "invalid" and password "doctor123" in the login form
    Then I should see an error message "Invalid username or password"

  Scenario: Invalid Password
    Given the Admin has set up the Doctor with default password "doctor123"
    And the Admin has set up the Chemist with default password "chemist123"
    And the Admin has set up the Lab with default password "lab123"
    When I enter the username "doctor" and password "invalid" in the login form
    Then I should see an error message "Invalid username or password"

  Scenario Outline: Successful Login with Different Users
    Given the Admin has set up the Doctor with default password "doctor123"
    And the Admin has set up the Chemist with default password "chemist123"
    And the Admin has set up the Lab with default password "lab123"
    When I enter the username "<username>" and password "<password>" in the login form
    Then I should see the "<username>'s" dashboard
    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | doctor   | doctor123 |
      | chemist  | chemist123 |
      | lab      | lab123     |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid Login with Different Users
    Given the Admin has set up the Doctor with default password "doctor123"
    And the Admin has set up the Chemist with default password "chemist123"
    And the Admin has set up the Lab with default password "lab123"
    When I enter the username "<username>" and password "<password>" in the login form
    Then I should see an error message "Invalid username or password"
    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | invalid  | doctor123 |
      | doctor   | invalid   |
      | lab      | lab123     |
```
